# P9. (a) RESET / RUN RULE, and what an UNMEASURED quarter does (DAEDALUS's surviving ASK (i) - ADS and CCLFX exercise it). The run is PER VEHICLE and counts CONSECUTIVE quarters. IT DOES NOT PAUSE IT. Reason: a PAUSE would assert a run ACROSS a quarter I cannot observe - inferring the unobserved in the direction of my book, which is the same defect this file already rules against for ADS ('inference does not count'). !! CASE (3) IS NOT A BENIGN READ AND MUST NOT BE FILED AS ONE: a vehicle SUSPENDING its repurchase programme is a MORE severe fact than a sub-100% quarter, and this gate is not built to grade it - record it as NO-OFFER, break the run, and route it SEPARATELY to WALTER as a red signal. Laundering a suspension into a run count is the failure mode.
